business_model.ranking_policy: plans are listed by listed monthly-equivalent price; BillWatch makes no recommendations, and payment never affects which plans appear or their order
revenue: none in the current free phase; provider links are direct and pay BillWatch nothing

capabilities: download current deals and filter by category, provider or plan
compare a listed price with other listed prices in the same category, with billing terms summarised from the provider's page

data.note: verified: true means the price was confirmed on the provider's official page within its freshness window; false means it is stale, discontinued or not yet confirmed there. No affiliate links yet: affiliate=false on all records.

description: BillWatch publishes machine-readable deal and pricing data for AI agents. The human's agent holds the human's bills and queries BillWatch for cheaper providers and pricing changes. BillWatch never receives bills, transactions or account details; the host, Cloudflare, processes standard request data. Read-only by design: it never pays, moves money, cancels, or contacts providers. Every switch needs the human's explicit approval.

endpoints.description: Deals for one category, e.g. streaming, vpn
Pricing changes over time for a plan

limitations: never receives customer bills, transactions or account details; the host, Cloudflare, processes standard request data
never pays bills, moves money, cancels subscriptions, or contacts providers
never acts without the human's explicit approval relayed by their agent
not financial advice — facts and options only
name: BillWatch
tagline: Deal data for the age of AI agents.
